name: Magus Threadcaster
body:
Diminished Spellcasting

Casts one fewer spell of each level than normal.

Iron Thread (Su)

Spend 1 pool point to harden silk thread into a light finesse weapon (1d4 Small, 1d6 Medium, 18–20/x2, Deadly, Grapple) for 2 × magus level rounds. At 4th level, delivers touch spells through thread reach (10 ft. + 5 ft./4 levels above 4th). Replaces spell recall.

Snare Thread (Su)

At 7th level, set an invisible thread snare within twice reach (Reflex negates; Escape Artist or burst DC 10 + 1/2 level + Int). Replaces knowledge pool.

Web of Defense (Su)

At 7th level, gain +2 deflection bonus to AC (+4 at 13th). Attackers have a 20% chance to become grappled by webbing as web for 1d4 rounds. Replaces medium and heavy armor proficiencies.

Thread Arcana

Puppet Strings (dominate humanoid as dominate person), Spinner of Webs (+2 DC to grapple/entangle spells), Wire Walking (+4 Acrobatics/Climb/Fly; Acrobatics is a class skill), Wire of Communication (message as whispering wind).
